export function approvalAskOf(event: {ask: string}): string {
  return event.ask
}

const modelOf = (row: {model: string}) => row.model

export type ConfigOf<Schema> = {schema: Schema}

interface Session {
  harnessOf: (threadId: string) => string
}

export function readHarness(session: Session, parentOf: string): string {
  return session.harnessOf(parentOf) + modelOf({model: 'm'})
}

export {modelOf}
